headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United eye USMNT's Balogun, Freeman for Pochettino
description: United States internationals Folarin Balogun and Alex Freeman could be following Mauricio Pochettino to Manchester United. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Alexis Mac Allister's father: No contract renewal talks with Liverpool yet
description: The father of Alexis Mac Allister has said that there have been no talks between his son and Liverpool but has also suggested there may be a breakthrough before the end of the year.

headline: Mauricio Pochettino agrees Man United deal, announcement expected - sources
description: Mauricio Pochettino has agreed to become the next Manchester United manager with an announcement expected on Friday, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Jack Grealish issues public apology after making Everton comeback in friendly
description: Jack Grealish has issued a public apology to Everton fans after he made his comeback in a behind-closed-doors match with Derby.
